answer: Postcard address proofs: a new identity requests a mailed card with a one-time code, sent to a verified postal address, and must enter it within 21 days. One address backs one identity per 90 days. A card costs 1.20 USD, so an honest user pays 1.20 USD while 1,000 fakes cost 1,200 USD plus 1,000 distinct addresses. Forwarding boxes fail: commercial agencies are flagged and the code is a cipher of the identity key. Validators audit 5% of addresses each epoch, follow any thread redirected twice, and slash 30 epochs of rewards. Limit: glacier camps need appeal.
